decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the firm's modular finishing know-how and complements its other systems, so the firm can keep interpreting and refining it at low risk.
As the B2 multifinishing flagship close to the firm's core competence, it fits the firm's move toward automated workflows, and the firm is well placed to learn from its market results.
The hybrid saddle stitcher draws on the firm's long-standing booklet-making expertise, which lets it absorb customer feedback and keep improving the product.
The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation running in one pass, so the firm has clear results to build on.
